columns_doc.first_height: first block whose config has new_value
columns_doc.old_value / new_value: the parameter as a decimal ([numerator, denominator] divided)
columns_doc.prev_height: the block just before it (config has old_value)
columns_doc.protocol_version: protocol_version in the config at first_height

description: Exact first block at which each tracked protocol parameter took a new value: max_inflation_rate (max_inflation_rate), burnt_gas_reward (runtime_config.transaction_costs.burnt_gas_reward).
incremental_rule: Change rows are immutable: an interval already explained by a recorded change (prev_height old value, first_height new value) is not searched again.
limits: A change that reverts between two consecutive config samples (about a month apart) is not seen. Values are never inferred: an unreadable config leaves its interval unsearched and listed in run.failed.
method: Candidate intervals are consecutive rows of rpc/protocol_config_samples.csv (history target heights + tip) whose values differ. Each is binary-searched with EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config {block_id: height}, moving past heights with no block, to the first height whose config has the new value. first_height's parent hash is checked to be prev_height's block hash, so no block lies between.
sampling: Configs are read at the monthly history_samples target heights plus the tip (rpc/protocol_config_samples.csv); each interval between two consecutive reads whose values differ is then bisected down to adjacent blocks. One row per change found.

units.old_value / new_value: dimensionless exact decimal (a fraction, not percent: 0.025 = 2.5%/year for max_inflation_rate, 0.3 = 30% of burnt gas for burnt_gas_reward)
